the pre breakdown current magnitudes and breakdown voltages are dependent on the electrode material, electrode geometry, supply frequency, electrode surface condition and electrode material.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PBD current magnitudes are directly proportional to the breakdown voltages, which in turn are directly proportional to supply frequency.
the breakdown voltage is not only a function of frequency, but is also dependent on the material properties of the electrode and the inter electrode spacing.

a vacuum gap is not a simple insulator.
the pre breakdown current and the breakdown voltage are not only dependent on the electrode material, but also on the supply frequency.
